sql.query: SELECT m.id,m.milestoneName,m.milestoneGroup,m.timingCategory,m.displayOrder,m.isActive,m.isDefault,CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) AS UNSIGNED) usageCount FROM tbl_event_milestones m LEFT JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.currentMilestoneId=m.id AND w.tenantId=m.tenantId WHERE m.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') AND r.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=m.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) GROUP BY m.id ORDER BY m.displayOrder,m.milestoneName,m.id
